name: Final Realms
english_description: A classic, from-scratch English-language MudOS mudlib whose own history dates to 1998 -- the oldest-vintage lib onboarded into this collection so far. A full game mudlib rather than a bare engine: 12 playable races with a real per-race starting zone, guilds, shops, taverns, and a full wizard toolset. The most severe porting bug: this driver build lacks the newer ed_start()/ed_cmd()/query_ed_mode() editor efuns this codebase's player-object code was written against (only the older single-efun ed() is available) -- left unfixed, this would have broken compilation of the entire player object, blocking every connection. Rewritten against the real ed() efun. A second mud-wide bug -- secure/gods.lpc/lords.lpc never defined the functions secure/master.lpc calls to build its admin-permission list, silently breaking wizard-permission checks for every account except the archive's own pre-blessed 'god' character -- was also fixed.
